scope: Generic source review and disposable local TLS fixtures only; no live operational data.
implementation: Use HTTPResponse.read1 with decoding disabled so available body bytes return to the existing monotonic deadline check; reset the socket timeout to the remaining budget before each read.

fixture.transport: Actual HTTP/1.1 over verified local TLS with a disposable private CA and localhost-only SAN certificate.
assertions: Deadline fails before the slow full body completes
One request reaches the server; no automatic retry
Partial response is discarded and pool permits return to zero
A later explicit request succeeds with no inherited response data

limitations: This narrow fix covers slow response body data after HTTP headers. It does not implement a separate cancellation timer for DNS, TLS, HTTP headers, or chunk framing/trailers handled inside http.client.
The documented urllib3 total/read timeout is not itself a hard wall-clock bound for every transport phase.
The 150ms fixture setting applies only inside the test; the production constant stays 12 seconds.
Local tests do not establish live capacity, soak latency, external operator certification, or independent security approval.
No Railway configuration, source pin, pending sandbox/production packet, or runtime changed as part of this follow-up.
